patch.description: Sets parent folder and position of folders and calendars; ones that are gone meanwhile are skipped.

get.description: Public calendars the user doesn't have through a direct membership or a group anyway.

put.description: Adds a public calendar to the sidebar, at its end; its public role applies (see get_membership).

delete.description: Takes a public calendar the user added out of the sidebar again.

post.description: A new feed URL for the user, e.g. after they shared theirs by mistake.

put.description: Sets the default approvers, who decide on resources that have none of their own.
Sets the resource's own approvers; without any, the calendar's default approvers decide.

get.description: Occurrences of several calendars at once; calendars the user can't read are skipped.

patch.description:
Changes one occurrence of a series ("this"), it and the later ones ("following"), or all.

`recurrence_id` is the original start of the occurrence; start and end in the payload are
the occurrence's new times. Returns the event that was changed.

delete.description: Removes one occurrence of a series ("this"), it and the later ones ("following"), or all.

get.description: The current user's own reminders for the event (of a series: for all its occurrences).

patch.description: Answers an invitation: sets the status of the current user's own participation.

get.description:
The numbers the app shows as badges: unread notifications, and requests still waiting for this user
(pending approvals and unanswered invitations).

post.description:
Busy periods only, no titles or details. Users can be looked up by anyone signed in, as in
the user search; resources only by members of their calendar. A POST, though it changes nothing:
see AvailabilityIn.

get.description:
The event as a file for calendar apps, without organizer and participants: anyone with the link may
load it, and answers are given on the page.

PublicSettingsOut.description:
What anyone may read, signed in or not. Listed field by field rather than taken from
AppSettingsOut, so a new setting stays with the admins until it is added here on purpose.
PublicSettingsOut.title: PublicSettingsOut

EmailNotifications.description: Which kinds of notifications also come by email.
EmailNotifications.title: EmailNotifications

ProfileOut.description: The signed-in user, as /users/me and the login and signup answers (core.headless_adapter) show them.
ProfileOut.title: ProfileOut

OkOut.description: The answer of endpoints that only do something, such as deleting.
OkOut.title: OkOut

PublicCalendarOut.description: A public calendar to add to the sidebar.
PublicCalendarOut.title: PublicCalendarOut

ApproversIn.description: The complete list of approvers; whoever is not in it is no approver any more.
ApproversIn.title: ApproversIn

AvailabilityIn.description: A query, sent as a body: the lists of ids would make for long URLs (and land in access logs).
AvailabilityIn.title: AvailabilityIn
